posts.title: Wall Street is falling
posts.text: Stocks are falling at the start of trading on Wall Street, as today’s US inflation report disappoints investors. The S&P 500 sharesindex has fallen by 0.4%, shedding 32 points to 7,773 points. The tech-focused Nasdaq is down 0.5%.

posts.title: US bond yields jump
posts.text: US government borrowing costs are pushing higher, after today’s inflation report hardened expectations of interest rate rises from the Fed.
